title: Computer Vision Input and Output Shapes

cues.en: So in the last video we covered what we're going to cover broadly and we saw some examples of what computer vision problems are.
cues.zh: 上一部影片，我們概覽接下來的內容，也看了一些電腦視覺問題的例子。

cues.en: Essentially anything that you're able to see, you can potentially turn into a computer vision problem.
cues.zh: 基本上，任何你看得見的東西，都可能轉成電腦視覺問題。

cues.en: And we're going to be cooking up lots of machine learning or specifically PyTorch computer vision code.
cues.zh: 我們會烹調出大量機器學習，具體來說是 PyTorch 電腦視覺程式。

cues.en: You see, I fix that typo.
cues.zh: 看，我修好那個拼字錯誤了。

cues.en: Now let's talk about what the inputs and outputs are of a typical computer vision problem.
cues.zh: 現在談典型電腦視覺問題的輸入與輸出。

cues.en: So let's start with a multi classification example.
cues.zh: 先從多類別分類例子開始。

cues.en: And so we wanted to take photos of different images of food and recognize what they were.
cues.zh: 想拍攝不同食物圖片，辨認它們是什麼。

cues.en: So we're replicating the functionality of Nujaifi.
cues.zh: 也就是重建剛才那個食物辨識 App 的功能。

cues.en: So take a photo of food and learn about it.
cues.zh: 拍張食物照片，了解它。

cues.en: So we might start with a bunch of food images that have a height and width of some sort.
cues.zh: 可能先有一批食物圖片，各自有某種高度與寬度。

cues.en: So we have width equals to 24 height equals to 24, and then they have three color channels.
cues.zh: 這裡寬 224、高 224，還有三個色彩通道。

cues.en: Why three?
cues.zh: 為什麼是三個？

cues.en: Well, that's because we have a value for red, green and blue.
cues.zh: 因為紅、綠、藍各有一個值。

cues.en: So if we look at this up.
cues.zh: 搜尋一下。

cues.en: If we go red, green, blue image format.
cues.zh: 搜尋 red green blue image format。

cues.en: So 24 bit AGB images.
cues.zh: 所以 24 位元 RGB 圖片。

cues.en: So.
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: A lot of images or digital images have some value for a red pixel, a green pixel and a blue pixel.
cues.zh: 許多圖片或數位圖片，都有紅、綠、藍像素的某些數值。

cues.en: And if you were to convert images into numbers, they get represented by some value of red, some value of green and some value of blue.
cues.zh: 如果把圖片轉成數字，就會以紅、綠、藍的數值來表示。

cues.en: That is exactly the same as how we'd represent these images.
cues.zh: 表示這些圖片時也完全一樣。

cues.en: So, for example, this pixel here might be a little bit more red, a little less blue and a little less green because it's close to orange.
cues.zh: 例如這裡的像素可能紅色多一點，藍色與綠色少一點，因為接近橘色。

cues.en: And then we convert that into numbers.
cues.zh: 再轉成數字。

cues.en: So what we're trying to do here is essentially what we're trying to do with all of the data that we have with machine learning is represented as numbers.
cues.zh: 所以這裡要做的，基本上與機器學習中處理所有資料相同，就是用數字表示。

cues.en: So the typical image format to represent an image because we're using computer vision.
cues.zh: 表示圖片的典型格式，因為做電腦視覺，

cues.en: So we're trying to figure out what's in an image.
cues.zh: 想知道圖片裡有什麼，

cues.en: The typical way to represent that is in a tensor that has a value for the height, width and color channels.
cues.zh: 常見表示方式，就是用包含高度、寬度與色彩通道的張量。

cues.en: And so we might numerically encode these, in other words, represent our images as a tensor, and this would be the inputs to our machine learning algorithm.
cues.zh: 所以可能先數值編碼，換句話說，把圖片表示成張量，作為機器學習演算法的輸入。

cues.en: And in many cases, depending on what problem you're working on, an existing algorithm already exist for many of the most popular computer vision problems.
cues.zh: 許多情況下，依你處理的問題，最常見的電腦視覺問題已經有現成演算法。

cues.en: And if it doesn't, you can build one.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，也可以自行建立。

cues.en: And then you might fashion this machine learning algorithm to output the exact shapes that you want.
cues.zh: 再讓機器學習演算法輸出你要的確切形狀。

cues.en: In our case, we want three outputs.
cues.zh: 我們這裡要三個輸出。

cues.en: We want one output for each class that we have.
cues.zh: 每個類別一個輸出。

cues.en: We want a prediction probability for sushi.
cues.zh: 要壽司的預測機率。

cues.en: We want a prediction probability for steak.
cues.zh: 要牛排的預測機率。

cues.en: And we want a prediction probability for pizza.
cues.zh: 要披薩的預測機率。

cues.en: Now, in our case, and this iteration looks like our model got one of them wrong because the highest value was assigned to the wrong class here.
cues.zh: 目前這一次，看起來模型有一個判斷錯了，因為最大值被指派到錯誤類別。

cues.en: So for the second image it assigned a prediction probability of 0.81 for sushi.
cues.zh: 第二張圖片，被指派為壽司的預測機率是 0.81。

cues.en: Now, keep in mind that you could change these classes to whatever your particular problem is.
cues.zh: 記得，可以依自己的問題，換成任何類別。

cues.en: I'm just simplifying this and making it three.
cues.zh: 我只是簡化成三種。

cues.en: You could have 100, you could have 1000, you could have five.
cues.zh: 可以有一百種、一千種，或五種。

cues.en: It's just it depends on what you're working with.
cues.zh: 取決於你處理什麼。

cues.en: And so we might use these predicted outputs to.
cues.zh: 接著可以用這些預測輸出，

cues.en: Enhance our app.
cues.zh: 改善應用程式。

cues.en: So if someone was to take a photo of their plate of sushi, our app might say, Hey, this is a photo of sushi.
cues.zh: 如果有人拍自己的壽司餐盤，App 可能會說，這是壽司的照片。

cues.en: Here's some information about those, the sushi rolls or the same for steak, the same for pizza.
cues.zh: 這是這些壽司捲的資訊，牛排與披薩也一樣。

cues.en: Now, it might not always get it right, because after all, that's what machine learning is.
cues.zh: 不一定每次都對，畢竟這就是機器學習，

cues.en: It's probabilistic.
cues.zh: 它具有機率性。

cues.en: So how would we improve these results here?
cues.zh: 如何改善這裡的結果？

cues.en: Well, we could show our model more and more images of sushi, steak and pizza so that it builds up a better internal representation of said images.
cues.zh: 可以讓模型看越來越多壽司、牛排與披薩圖片，建立更好的內部表示。

cues.en: So when it looks at images it's never seen before or images outside its training data set, it's able to get better results.
cues.zh: 這樣看到未見過的圖片，或訓練資料集以外的圖片，就能得到更好的結果。

cues.en: But just keep in mind, this whole process is similar.
cues.zh: 不過記得，整個流程都類似。

cues.en: No matter what computer vision problem you're working with, you need a way to numerically encode your information.
cues.zh: 不論做哪種電腦視覺問題，都需要把資訊數值編碼的方法。

cues.en: You need a machine learning model that's capable of fitting the data in the way that you would like it to be fit.
cues.zh: 需要能以你希望的方式擬合資料的機器學習模型。

cues.en: In our case, classification, you might have a different type of model if you're working with object detection, a different type of model, if you're working with segmentation, and then you need to fashion
cues.zh: 我們這裡做分類，如果是物件偵測，可能使用不同模型；做分割，也可能用不同模型，接著要把

cues.en: the outputs in a way that best suit your problem as well.
cues.zh: 輸出設計成最適合問題的方式。

cues.en: So let's push forward.
cues.zh: 繼續。

cues.en: Oh, by the way, the model that often does this is a convolutional neural network.
cues.zh: 對了，經常負責這件事的模型，就是卷積神經網路。

cues.en: In other words, a CNN.
cues.zh: 也就是 CNN。

cues.en: However, you can use many other different types of machine learning algorithms here.
cues.zh: 不過這裡也能使用許多其他機器學習演算法。

cues.en: It's just that convolutional neural networks typically perform the best with image data.
cues.zh: 只是卷積神經網路通常在圖片資料上表現最好。

cues.en: Although with recent research, there is the transformer architecture or deep learning model that also performs fairly well or very well with image data.
cues.zh: 不過，近期研究中，Transformer 架構或深度學習模型，在圖片資料上也表現相當好，甚至很好。

cues.en: So just keep that in mind going forward.
cues.zh: 之後記得這點。

cues.en: But for now, we're going to focus on convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 不過目前先專注卷積神經網路。

cues.en: And so we might have input and output shapes because remember, one of the chief machine learning problems is making sure that your tensor shapes line up with each other, the input and output shapes.
cues.zh: 所以會有輸入與輸出形狀，記得機器學習的主要問題之一，就是確保張量的輸入與輸出形狀彼此吻合。

cues.en: So if we encoded this image of stake here, we might have a dimensionality of batch size, width, height, color channels, and now the ordering here could be improved.
cues.zh: 如果把這張牛排圖片編碼，可能有批次大小、寬度、高度、色彩通道這些維度；這裡的順序可以改進。

cues.en: It's usually height than width, so alphabetical order and then color channels last.
cues.zh: 通常是先高度，再寬度，按英文字母順序，最後色彩通道。

cues.en: So we might have the shape of 92242, two, four, three.
cues.zh: 所以形狀可能是 (None, 224, 224, 3)。

cues.en: Now, where does this come from?
cues.zh: 這從哪裡來？

cues.en: So none could be the batch size.
cues.zh: None 可以是批次大小。

cues.en: Now it's none because we can set the batch size to whatever we want.
cues.zh: 設為 None，是因為批次大小可以自行決定。

cues.en: Say, for example, 32.
cues.zh: 例如 32。

cues.en: Then we might have a height of 2 to 4 and a width of 2 to 4 and three color channels.
cues.zh: 接著高度 224、寬度 224，以及三個色彩通道。

cues.en: Now, height and width are also customizable.
cues.zh: 高度與寬度也可以調整。

cues.en: You might change this to be 512 by 512.

What that would mean is that you have more numbers representing your image and in sense would take more computation to figure out the patterns because there is simply more information encoded in your image.
cues.zh: 表示用更多數字表示圖片，因此需要更多運算來找模式，因為圖片編碼的資訊單純就是更多。

cues.en: But two to 4 to 2 four is a common starting point for images.
cues.zh: 不過 224 × 224 是常見的圖片起點。

cues.en: And then 32 is also a very common batch size as we've seen in previous videos.
cues.zh: 32 也是非常常見的批次大小，前面影片看過。

cues.en: But again, this could be changed depending on the hardware you're using.
cues.zh: 不過同樣可以依使用的硬體調整。

cues.en: Depending on the model you're using, you might have a batch size of 64.
cues.zh: 依使用的模型，也許批次大小是 64，

cues.en: You might have a batch size of 512.
cues.zh: 也可能是 512。

cues.en: It's all problem specific.
cues.zh: 都取決於問題。

cues.en: And that's this line here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡這句話。

cues.en: These will vary depending on the problem you're working on.
cues.zh: 會依處理的問題而改變。

cues.en: So in our case, our output shape is three because we have three different classes for now.
cues.zh: 我們目前輸出形狀是 3，因為有三個不同類別。

cues.en: But again, if you out of 100, you might have an output shape of 100.
cues.zh: 不過如果有一百個，就可能輸出形狀 100。

cues.en: If you have 1000, you might have an output shape of 1000.
cues.zh: 有一千個，就可能是 1000。

cues.en: The same premise of this whole pattern remains though numerically encode your data, feed it into a model, and then make sure the output shape fits your specific problem.
cues.zh: 整個模式的原理相同：數值編碼資料，餵給模型，確保輸出形狀符合特定問題。

cues.en: And so for this section, computer vision with PyTorch, we're going to be building scenes to do this part.
cues.zh: 所以這一章，使用 PyTorch 進行電腦視覺，要建立 CNN，完成這一部分。

cues.en: We're actually going to do all of the parts here, but we're going to focus on building a convolutional neural network to try and find patterns in data because it's not always guaranteed that it will.
cues.zh: 實際上所有部分都會做，不過會著重在建立卷積神經網路，試著找出資料模式，因為不是保證一定找得到。

cues.en: Finally, let's look at one more problem.
cues.zh: 最後再看一個問題。

cues.en: So you had greyscale images of fashion items and you have quite small images there, only 28 by 28.
cues.zh: 假設有服飾物品的灰階圖片，而且很小，只有 28 × 28。

cues.en: The exact same pattern is going to happen.
cues.zh: 同樣的模式會發生。

cues.en: You numerically represent it.
cues.zh: 以數值表示，

cues.en: Use it as inputs to a machine learning algorithm.
cues.zh: 作為機器學習演算法輸入。

cues.en: And then hopefully your machine learning algorithm outputs the right type of clothing that it is in this case is a t shirt.
cues.zh: 接著希望演算法輸出正確的服飾類型，這裡是 T 恤。

cues.en: But I've got a dot, dot, dot here because we're going to be working on a problem that uses ten different types of items of clothing, and the image is are grayscale.
cues.zh: 不過我放了省略號，因為要處理十種不同服飾，而且圖片是灰階的。

cues.en: So there's not much detail.
cues.zh: 所以細節不多。

cues.en: So hopefully our machine learning algorithm can recognize what's going on in these images.
cues.zh: 希望機器學習演算法認得出圖片裡是什麼。

cues.en: There might be a boot, there might be a shirt, there might be pants.
cues.zh: 可能是靴子、襯衫、長褲，

cues.en: But we numerically encode our images in two dimensionality of batch size height with color channels.
cues.zh: 把圖片數值編碼為批次大小、高度、寬度、色彩通道這些維度。

cues.en: This is known as n WC or number of batches or number of images in a batch, height, width, C or color channels.
cues.zh: 稱為 NHWC，N 是批次大小，或一批圖片的張數，H 是高度，W 是寬度，C 是色彩通道。

cues.en: This is color channels last.
cues.zh: 這是色彩通道在最後。

cues.en: Why am I showing you two forms of this?
cues.zh: 為什麼要示範兩種形式？

cues.en: Do you notice color channels in this?
cues.zh: 注意到這個的色彩通道了嗎？

cues.en: One is color channels first.
cues.zh: 一種是色彩通道在前。

cues.en: So color channels, height width.
cues.zh: 所以是色彩通道、高度、寬度。

cues.en: Well, because you come across a lot of different representations of data, full stop, but particularly image data in PyTorch and other libraries, many libraries expect color channels last.
cues.zh: 因為你會遇到各種資料表示方式，尤其是 PyTorch 與其他函式庫中的圖片資料。很多函式庫預期色彩通道在最後。

cues.en: However, PyTorch, currently at the time of recording this video may change in the future.
cues.zh: 不過 PyTorch 目前，也就是錄製這部影片時，未來可能改變，

cues.en: Defaults to representing image data with color channels first.
cues.zh: 預設用色彩通道在前的方式表示圖片。

cues.en: Now, this is very important because you will get errors if your dimensionality is in the wrong order.
cues.zh: 很重要，因為維度順序不對就會出錯。

cues.en: And so there are ways to go in between these two and there's a lot of debate of which format is the best.
cues.zh: 可以在這兩種方式之間轉換，也有很多關於哪種格式最好的討論。

cues.en: It looks like colored channels last is going to win over the long term just because it's more efficient.
cues.zh: 看起來長期而言，色彩通道放最後會勝出，因為效率更高。

cues.en: But again, that's outside the scope.
cues.zh: 不過這超出課程範圍。

cues.en: And so we could rearrange these shapes to how we want colored channels last or color channels first.
cues.zh: 所以可以把這些形狀重排成想要的方式，色彩通道在最後，或在前面。

cues.en: And once again, the shapes will vary depending on the problem that you're working on.
